name: get_peer_material_topics
description: Material responsible business conduct issues (BRSR Section A) for a cohort of peers, from the scraped corpus. Per NSE symbol it returns the latest topics-extracted filing (or the requested FY's, when extracted) with each disclosed row: verbatim topic, Risk/Opportunity flag, truncated rationale, and — where mapped — a canonical-topic + pillar hint (environment/social/governance/cross_cutting) from the LLM canon cache. `missing` lists symbols with no topics-extracted filing. Batched: call ONCE with all symbols. 1-15 symbols, clamped server-side — strict tool-use schemas reject array/numeric bounds.

financial_year.description: Optional FY label like "2024-25"; default = each peer's latest topics-extracted filing

name: emit_material_topics_table
description: Return the complete deduplicated material-topics table (topics with description, pillar and disclosing peers + coverage lists + methodology + caveats). Call exactly once when finished.
